#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed Stationeers server — generated by provision().
# This server's own files: <ROOT>/installs/stationeers/gamedash-servers/test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
cd "<ROOT>/installs/stationeers/" || exit 1
exec ./rocketstation_DedicatedServer.x86_64 -batchmode -nographics -logFile "<ROOT>/installs/stationeers/gamedash-servers/test/server.log" -settingspath "<ROOT>/installs/stationeers/gamedash-servers/test/setting.xml" -load gd_test Lunar -settings StartLocalHost true LocalIpAddress 0.0.0.0 UPNPEnabled false UseSteamP2P false ServerVisible true GamePort 27510 UpdatePort 27511 ServerName "Test World" ServerPassword "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" ServerMaxPlayers 10 AutoSave true SaveInterval 300 AutoPauseServer true
